# IDistributor
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/core-contracts/src/interfaces/merkl/IDistributor.sol)

**Title:**
IDistributor

Interface for the Merkl Merkle-based rewards distributor


## Functions
### toggleOperator

Toggles whether an operator is authorized to claim on behalf of a user


```solidity
function toggleOperator(address user, address operator) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|The user granting or revoking the operator|
|`operator`|`address`|The operator to toggle|


### claim

Claims rewards for multiple users and tokens using Merkle proofs


```solidity
function claim(
    address[] calldata users,
    address[] calldata tokens,
    uint256[] calldata amounts,
    bytes32[][] calldata proofs
)
    external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`users`|`address[]`|The recipients of the claims|
|`tokens`|`address[]`|The reward tokens to claim, aligned with users|
|`amounts`|`uint256[]`|The cumulative amounts to claim, aligned with users/tokens|
|`proofs`|`bytes32[][]`|The Merkle proofs for each claim|


### operators

Returns whether an operator is authorized for a user (non-zero if authorized)


```solidity
function operators(address user, address operator) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`user`|`address`|The user to query|
|`operator`|`address`|The operator to query|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|Non-zero if the operator is authorized for the user|
